digest.component_or_area: build system and CI / type checking infrastructure
propositions: mypy typecheck target only covers src/rebar, leaving 47 .py files in scripts/ lint-clean but type-unchecked despite CI-invoked gate scripts residing there

15 type errors surface when scripts/ is included in mypy scope: 7 in check_raw_git_writes.py, 4 in plan_review_impact_distribution.py, and 1 each in capture_jira_fixtures.py, probe_rebar.py, check_complexity_baseline.py, t5c_calibrate.py
latent bugs exist in scripts: capture_jira_fixtures calls .strip() on str | None, and check_complexity_baseline passes possibly-None dict where dict[str, int] is required
stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml incorrectly state typecheck covers only src/rebar or full library without scripts/ qualifier
sys.path bootstrap mutations in 9 scripts files are already handled by pyproject.toml's follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports settings
